problem: Prior object navigation methods handle single goals; chaining them for multi-object tasks treats each task independently, without global optimization, so trajectories overlap and navigation is inefficient.
motivation: Real-life human demands are continuous and multiple, so agents must carry out several goal-object tasks in sequence. Removing non-effective actions (overlapping trajectories, aimless exploration) requires reusing long-term memory of the environment across sub-tasks.
key_idea: An RL framework with a hybrid policy that uses a memorized semantic map and object-relation prior knowledge to predict a potential target position, then plans a path to it, with long-term planning when the target is already seen and relation-guided exploration otherwise.
insight: Reusing a semantic map as long-term memory across sequential goals, plus object co-occurrence priors to guess where an unseen target may be, reduces redundant trajectories. Only the abstract was available, so no ablations can be cited.
method: Semantic entity detection and memory: visual observations are embedded to detect objects, which are stored in memory.
Semantic map projection: detected objects are projected into a semantic map serving as long-term memory of the environment.
Hybrid policy: combines exploration and long-term planning strategies to predict the potential target position.
Long-term planning: when the target is already observed, plans on the semantic map and executes as a sequence of motion actions.
Relation-based exploration: when the target is not observed, uses prior object-relation knowledge combined with the semantic map to estimate the potential target position and plans a path to it.

setting.backbone: RL-trained policy network with semantic-map memory (details not given in abstract)
setting.training_data: Not stated in abstract; trained with reinforcement learning on Gibson and Matterport3D; object-relation prior knowledge used
setting.observation: visual observations (egocentric, likely RGB-D) projected into a semantic map
